web.title: Bachpan Photo Pehchano: Childhood Photo Kitty Party Game
web.description: Bachpan Photo Pehchano is a childhood photo guessing game for kitty parties. Learn how to play, what you need, the bluff twist, rules and tips.
web.intro: Bachpan Photo Pehchano is a guessing game where the host shows a childhood photo of each lady and everyone writes down who they think it is. Every correct guess scores 1 point and the lady with the most points at the end wins. The crazy twist: the lady in the photo also writes a guess, naming someone else to bluff the room, and if more than half the room gets her wrong she earns 2 points. It needs only old photos, a phone, paper and pens, and is perfect around Children's Day.
materials: One childhood photo of every lady, sent privately to the host on WhatsApp a day before
The host's phone, or a TV to cast the photos on a bigger screen
A sheet of paper and a pen for every lady
A phone timer set to 30 seconds
steps: A day before the kitty, every lady privately sends the host one childhood photo. Nobody else sees them.
On the day, give every lady a sheet with numbers 1 to 15 (or as many as there are players). Each number is one photo.
The host shows the photos one by one, turning the phone around the room, and everyone has 30 seconds to write the name they think it is.
The lady in the photo writes too, but she writes someone else's name and keeps a straight face so nobody can tell it is her.
After the last photo, the host reveals each name. Every correct guess is 1 point, and if more than half the room guessed wrong, the lady in that photo gets 2 points.
rules: If the lady in the photo laughs or gives herself away, she loses her bluff bonus for that photo.
Copying from the lady sitting next to you cancels your point for that photo.
Names written after the 30 second timer do not count.
The lady with the most points is the Bachpan Queen.
variations: Show only the eyes of each photo and cover the rest with your hand.
Mix in childhood photos of the husbands to confuse everyone.
In the final round, show each photo for just 5 seconds.
tips: Collect photos on WhatsApp a day before so nobody forgets an album at home.
Ask ladies to pick a photo from age 3 to 10; baby photos are too hard and teen photos too easy.
Cast the photos on the TV if the group is bigger than 12 so everyone sees at once.
Keep one fun prize for the lady who fooled the most people.

faq.q: How many players do you need for Bachpan Photo Pehchano?
faq.a: It works for 8 to 20 ladies. Each lady brings one photo, so a bigger group simply means more photos to guess.

faq.q: What do you need for a childhood photo guessing game?
faq.a: One childhood photo of every lady, the host's phone or a TV, a sheet of paper and a pen for each player and a 30 second phone timer.

faq.q: Is Bachpan Photo Pehchano good for a Children's Day kitty party?
faq.a: Yes. It brings back school day memories, needs no setup and gets everyone laughing at old hairstyles and frocks, which suits a Children's Day theme perfectly.

faq.q: How do you score the childhood photo game?
faq.a: Every correct guess is 1 point. The lady in the photo writes a fake guess, and if more than half the room gets her wrong she earns 2 points.

faq.q: What if someone does not have a childhood photo?
faq.a: She can click a photo of an old album page or a school ID, or play as the host who shows the photos and keeps the score.
